title: NHK World — 和食の基本 (Washoku: Japanese Cuisine Basics)
description: Part of NHK World's cultural programming series. Introduces the fundamentals of washoku (traditional Japanese cuisine): dashi broth from kombu and katsuobushi, rice cooking technique, miso soup, and the classic ichiju-sansai (one soup, three dishes) meal structure. Narration mixes accessible N5 and N4 vocabulary.
